name: Massmore_BNO08x
description: Complete driver for the BNO085 / BNO086 9-axis sensor fusion IMU. Full SH-2 / SHTP implementation over I2C, SPI and UART, plus UART-RVC. Every sensor report from basic quaternions to the personal activity classifier and the 1 kHz gyro-integrated rotation vector. Includes chip identity and authenticity verification, calibration, tare, FRS access and power management. No external dependencies, no dynamic allocation.
